subject: Staffing + leaderboard scope — irregular TS pretraining
body: Dmitri — staffing plus the one scope addition from Friday. Core: Freya 60% (pretraining recipes), Kaia 40% (clinical eval design), Maren 40% (data pipelines + mask caching), Saoirse 50%. The addition: for the benchmark suite to actually get adopted, teams need results they can see and submit to, and nothing internal does this today — so we're scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch: run ingestion from the eval harness, ranking views per dataset and metric, and submission auth. Saoirse owns it within her 50%; Maren supports the ingestion path. Compute: titan best-effort is plenty (these models are small); the storage ask to Corpus for the pre-generated geometric mask banks (~400 GB) is filed. Risk on record: eICU access approval is still pending and historically takes 4-6 weeks — the three-dataset milestone may need H&M substituted for eICU. — Ivo
